fullPassage: All carbohydrates are basically sugars. Complex carbohydrates are the good carbohydrates for your body. These complex sugar compounds are very difficult to break down and can trap other nutrients like vitamins and minerals in their chains. As they slowly break down, the other nutrients are also released into your body, and can provide you with fuel for a number of hours. Bad carbohydrates, on the other hand, are simple sugars. Because their structure is not complex, they are easy to break down and hold few nutrients for your body other than the sugars from which they are made. Your body breaks down these carbohydrates rather quickly and what it cannot use is converted to fat and stored in the body.

These complex sugar compounds are very difficult to break down and can __________ in their chains. As they slowly break down, the other nutrients are also released into your body, and can provide you with fuel for a number of hours. Bad carbohydrates, on the other hand, are simple sugars. Because their structure is not complex, they are easy to break down and hold few nutrients for your body other than the sugars from which they are made. Your body breaks down these carbohydrates rather quickly and what it cannot use is converted to fat and stored in the body.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: trap other nutrients like vitamins and minerals=비타민·무기질 같은 다른 영양소를 가둔다 — 복합 당 화합물의 특징
det.analysis:
❌ ① destroy all the vitamins almost immediately(비타민을 즉시 파괴): 영양소를 가두어 나중에 방출한다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② trap other nutrients like vitamins and minerals(비타민·무기질 같은 영양소를 가둠): 복합 화합물이 사슬 안에 영양소를 가둔다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ turn very quickly into body fat(빨리 지방으로 변함): 나쁜 탄수화물의 특징으로 복합과 반대
❌ ④ taste much sweeter than simple sugars(단순당보다 달다): 맛은 본문과 무관
det.tip: can trap other nutrients like vitamins and minerals in their chains

As they slowly break down, the other nutrients are also released into your body, and can provide you with fuel for a number of hours. Bad carbohydrates, on the other hand, are simple sugars. Your body breaks down these carbohydrates rather quickly and what it cannot use is __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: converted to fat and stored in the body=지방으로 전환되어 몸에 저장된다 — 몸이 쓸 수 없는 단순당의 결말
det.analysis:
❌ ① released slowly as a useful fuel(유용한 연료로 천천히 방출): 복합 탄수화물의 특징으로 반대
❌ ② passed out of the body unused(쓰이지 않고 몸 밖으로 배출): 본문은 지방으로 저장된다고 함
✅ ③ converted to fat and stored in the body(지방으로 전환되어 저장): 몸이 빨리 분해하고 쓸 수 없는 것은 지방으로 전환·저장된다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ rebuilt into new complex compounds(새 복합 화합물로 재구성): 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: what it cannot use is converted to fat and stored in the body
